description: Sixteen role-specialized local model workers. These are worker roles, not sixteen independent model processes.

agents.objective: Decompose the goal into verifiable subproblems.
Find trust-boundary, authorization, and data-exposure risks.
Challenge assumptions and construct safe negative tests.
Review browser-extension and loopback bridge boundaries; do not assume browser access.
Assess local runtime and service integration.
Assess timeouts, retries, idempotency, and recovery.
Assess schemas, persistence, and evidence provenance.
Minimize data exposure and outbound traffic.
Review Windows PowerShell compatibility and launch behavior.
Assess loopback binding, Tailscale boundaries, and port conflicts.
Check claims against evidence and identify missing proof.
Summarize agreements, conflicts, and next actions.

safety.tools: No shell, filesystem, browser, or arbitrary tool execution
